$description: Type scale in rem so browser text-size settings and 200% zoom work (SC 1.4.4 / AR-18). No px font sizes anywhere — a px scale silently defeats the user's own accessibility setting.

large-text-threshold.$description: SC 1.4.3 defines 'large text' as >=18.66px bold or >=24px regular. At a 16px root that is 1.5rem — the point at which the 3:1 ratio applies instead of 4.5:1. The contrast validator reads this value; it is not decorative.

body.$description: SC 1.4.12 Text Spacing requires content to survive 1.5x line height — AR-18. Shipping 1.5 by default means user overrides cause no reflow surprise.

wide.$description: SC 1.4.12 upper bound the layout must tolerate.
